_comment: Sample run config for gen-prompts.py --group partner (DM-X, review fix F-05, 2026-10-27). Run sample01, env e2e-x-sample01, logins dmseed-<role> and ids are fakes: fill employees from the R1 claims / partner-allocation.md (seed P-PTN-7; ERX optional = a claimed spare). Days follow rules.json DAY_RULES for R = 2026-11-03 (seed P-PTN-9): ST_DAY a seeded weekday >= R+2 inside roster_end, SR_DAY >= R+3, RRX_DAY >= R+3 and listed in painted_days (ERX painted, P-PTN-9b), CM_DAY in the current month, NM_DAY in the next month, XD1..XD8 eight consecutive weekdays >= R+7 after roster_end, XD7N = XD7 + 1, XD9 / XD10 = XD8 + 1 / + 2; LEAD_DAY is computed. Supplied by the steward or the user, fake here: PARTNER_ID (stage/run-partner), GLN (stage/gln, 13 digits, run-unique), PROVIDER_CODE (stage/provider-gate), PH_NODE and SPX_NODE (KNOTEN_ID of Notfallzentrum / Intensivpflege), PORTAL_PROFILE and POMA_OPS_PROFILE (headed ops sign-ins, outside results/); RUN_TAG = 8 characters [a-z0-9]. Test: gen-prompts.py <this file> --group partner --dry-run (exit 0, no NEEDS CONFIG line); a real run adds --claims.
